entities.summary: Daniel Rahimi is a Swedish former professional ice hockey defenceman who last played for IF Björklöven in the Hockeyallsvenskan (Allsv.). He was selected by the Vancouver Canucks in the third round of the 2006 NHL Entry Draft.
